assumptions: CLI route `--metric butteraugli` -> zenmetrics-api compute_butter_multi (cpu_dispatch.rs:1523-1549) -> butteraugli::butteraugli (lib.rs:695) ONE-SHOT path: both images fully processed per call (warm ButteraugliReference caching exists but the umbrella's multi-column emit uses the stateless entry).
Source = sibling path dep ~/work/butteraugli/butteraugli @ a2ce2135 (workspace patch in Cargo.toml:479; declared version 0.9.4).

Structure (diff.rs:819-860,724-760): sRGB->linear LUT, then at TWO resolutions (full + half when W,H>=15; MIN_SIZE_FOR_SUBSAMPLE diff.rs:733) : opsin XYB conversion + separate_frequencies + malta diffs + mask + combine; add_supersampled_2x folds half-res diffmap into full-res; single-pass max + 3-norm score. levels=2 with elements scaled by 2**l models the half-res repeat (ceil dims).
sRGB->linear is a 256-entry LUT lookup per byte (imgref_srgb_to_linear_f32 diff.rs:890): counted as gather loads, no arithmetic.

Opsin dynamics (opsin.rs:175-277): 3 planes blurred with sigma=1.2 5-tap mirrored separable (blur_mirrored_5x5), then per-pixel: 6 intensity muls, 3x opsin_absorbance (3mul+3add+2cmp) on blurred, 3x gamma = fast_log2f (opsin.rs:54-87: bit-extract int ops + 2 Horner fma chains + div) + K_RET muladd, 3x sens div+clamp, 3x absorbance*sens on unblurred, X/Y/B emit. Counted as written.

Frequency separation (psycho.rs:367-628): LF = 3x gaussian_blur sigma 7.156 -> kernel 2*floor(2.25*7.156)+1 = 33 taps (blur.rs:61-80); MF = 3x sigma 3.225 -> 15 taps; UHF = 2x sigma 1.564 -> 7 taps (X,Y only; B has no HF/UHF). Per plane per axis: kernel_len fma + kernel_len loads; h writes scratch, v writes out.

Post-processing per band: MF_x remove_range, MF_Y amplify_range, suppress_x_by_y on HF_X; UHF X = remove_range(orig-blurred), Y = maximum_clamp chain (psycho.rs:283-360). Blurred->LF uses mem::swap (no copy).

Malta (malta.rs:107-331, diff.rs:255-418): scaled-diff precompute pass per band (abs/norm/asymmetric penalty ~13 ops), then 16-pattern squared-line-sum filter: HF/UHF patterns = 132 taps (9x9) per el on 4 planes (uhf_x,uhf_y,hf_x,hf_y); MF planes use malta_unit_lf (5-sample lines, 80 taps) on 2 planes. Zero-pad 4-px border on the diff plane makes every output interior (border fill counted ~0).

Mask (mask.rs:369-410): fused combine_channels_for_masking+diff_precompute per image (2 sqrt), gaussian_blur MASK_RADIUS=2.7 -> 13-tap (diff=6), fuzzy_erosion K=3 (9-point weighted min3, ~24 cmp/select + 2 fma + 1 mul) on ref blur only, accumulate_mask_to_error into diff_ac[1].
combine_channels_to_diffmap_fused (diff.rs:440-511): per px mask_y + mask_dc_y rational forms, 3-channel masked DC diff from LF vals + masked AC fold + sqrt.
Score (diff.rs:524-590): single pass max + f64 d^3,d^6,d^12 power sums; finalize 3 powf (constant, folded into note).
Identical-input early-out (diff.rs:835) NOT counted (distinct-input path). diffmap produced but is the metric output itself (not waste). Sub-8px reflect_pad_to_min: no-op at eval shapes.
Half-res block: subsample_linear_rgb_2x is a 2x2 box mean in linear space (diff.rs:593-670); supersample add is dest-aware (weight 0.5, blend 0.85).

Halo: dominated by LF blur radius 16 (scale 2^l per level); Malta radius 4; mask blur 6; fuzzy 3. depends_on chains accumulate conservatively across resolutions (level-uniform stages share dep lists).

stages.name: sRGB8 -> linear f32 via 256-entry LUT (3 ch)
stages.notes: 3 u8 loads + 3 f32 LUT gathers + 3 plane stores per px.

stages.name: 2x2 box mean in linear RGB -> half-res
stages.notes: Interior blocks only; edge columns use 0.5-scaled pairs (~equal ops).

stages.name: sigma=1.2 5-tap mirrored separable blur, 3 RGB planes
stages.notes: 5 fma+5 ld per axis per el; mirrored borders same count.

stages.name: per-pixel opsin dynamics: absorbance + gamma + XYB emit
stages.notes: 6 intensity mul + 9mul/9add blurred absorbance + 3x fast_log2f (4fma+div+2add+~4int bit-ops+cmp) + 3 sens div/cmp + 12mul/9add cur + XYB sub/add.

stages.name: sigma 7.156 33-tap separable blur x3 -> LF planes
stages.notes: 33 taps x h + v per plane. Border pixels use renormalized kernels (same count).

stages.name: MF = XYB - LF (3 ch subtract)
stages.notes: subtract_images per plane.

stages.name: LF -> vals space (xmul/ymul/y_to_b fma)
stages.notes: b = y_to_b.fma(y, b)*bmul; x *= xmul; y *= ymul.

stages.name: sigma 3.225 15-tap separable blur x3 (MF->HF split)
stages.notes: 15 taps x2 axes on mf_x, mf_y, mf_b.

stages.name: HF subtract + MF range ops + suppress_x_by_y
stages.notes: Per px: hf_x/hf_y subtract (2 add + 4 ld + 2 st), remove_range mf_x, amplify_range mf_y, suppress_x_by_y (fma+div+fma+mul + 2ld + st).

stages.name: sigma 1.564 7-tap separable blur on hf_x, hf_y
stages.notes: B channel has no UHF split.

stages.name: process_uhf_hf_x (2x remove_range) + _y (clamp chain)
stages.notes: X: sub+abs+cmp+copysign per band x2. Y: 2x maximum_clamp (min,max,sub,fma) + muls + amplify_range.

stages.name: scaled asymmetric diffs into zero-padded plane, 6 bands
stages.notes: malta_compute_scaled_diffs per band pair (uhf x,y + hf x,y + mf x,y): absval, inv_norm div, scaled_diff + branch-free below/above penalty. Padded plane border zero-fill ~0.1 st/el extra.

stages.name: Malta 16-pattern 132-tap filter on uhf/hf x,y (4 planes)
stages.notes: 16 patterns: 10 x 9-sample + 6 x 7-sample sums (128+16 adds) + 16 sum^2 mul + 16 accumulate adds.

stages.name: Malta LF variant 5-sample patterns on mf x,y (2 planes)
stages.notes: 16 patterns x 5 taps: 64 add + 16 mul + 16 add.

stages.name: plane_x/y += hf + mf malta diffs
stages.notes: accumulate_two: d += a + b.

stages.name: L2DiffAsymmetric on hf x,y
stages.notes: diff^2*w0gt1 accumulate + branch-free 0.4/1.05 asymmetry term.

stages.name: L2Diff mf x,y + write-only mf_b
stages.notes: x,y accumulate (sub+mul+fma, 3ld); b write (sub+2mul, 2ld).

stages.name: fused combine_channels_for_masking + diff_precompute
stages.notes: sqrt(xdiff^2 + ydiff^2) then sqrt(MASK_MUL*v + bias) - sqrt_bias; hf+uhf of each image.

stages.name: gaussian_blur MASK_RADIUS 2.7 (13-tap) on diff0,diff1
stages.notes: diff=max(2.25*2.7,1)=6 -> 13 taps per axis.

stages.name: fuzzy_erosion K=3 weighted min3 (ref side only)
stages.notes: 8x update_min3 (~2-3 cmp each + selects) + init 2*c + out = 0.45*m0 + 0.3*m1 + 0.25*m2. Border rows similar count.

stages.name: mask-weighted AC + DC fold -> diffmap (sqrt)
stages.notes: mask_y + mask_dc_y rational (fma+div+fma+mul each), 3-ch masked dc diff (3 sub + ~6 mul + 2 fma), ac fold (2 mul + 2 fma), add + sqrt.

stages.name: add_supersampled_2x sub-diffmap -> full-res (w=0.5)
stages.notes: d = d*blend + 0.5*src[y/2][x/2]; sub-diffmap read at quarter density.

stages.name: max-norm + f64 3/6/12-power sums -> score & pnorm3
stages.notes: Per px: max cmp + f64 d3 (2 mul) d6 (1) d12 (1) + 3 acc adds. Finalize: 3 powf + mean div + 2 add (constant, ~9 flops total).
